sections.title: The Dry Cell (Zinc-Carbon)
points: Brass Cap (+): The positive terminal connected to the Carbon rod.
Zinc Can (-): The container and negative terminal.
Ammonium Chloride: The electrolyte paste that allows electrons to move.
Manganese IV Oxide: The Depolarizer. It stops hydrogen bubbles from blocking the current.

sections.text: Exam Tip: Cells in Series (+ to -) give more voltage/brightness. Cells in Parallel last much longer but have less 'push'.
